answer: PathWarden pings every identity on a random schedule, requiring a live inbound handshake from its own routable address. TraceShadow voids any pair whose traceroutes share a last-mile router within six hops or answer inside the same 30 ms window, slashing both 40-unit bonds. A residential line runs $12 a month, so 50 fakes cost $600, 50 addresses, a week of warming — a voyage through proxy vendors that still beaches on one exchange while the tide of new keys rises. An honest agent needs one line. Fifty keys off one doorstep carry the same grain as one timber.
